items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: we'd all play together. Bandra and guitar, you know. And he would sing, you know.

ctx.x: He said, what about Albert French? Yeah, do you know him? Yeah, he used to sing and, you know, play, Tone of Bandra, play guitar. I learned about play. You know, he can play a little, but he couldn't play much on Tone of Bandra. And I learned to him, oh, what do you know about Tone of Bandra? But I didn't learn how to play guitar. When he wakes up to see a cell phone guitar, then he went for a cell phone guitar, then he went for a cell phone guitar, then he went for a cell phone guitar until he died. I think, I…

I bought him out. He never would forget me. If he got a little three or four piece jar, he'd come lick me up, come and get me, and we'd all play together. Bandra and guitar, you know. And he would sing, you know.
